title: Cell Biology and Genetics: Main Exam, 19 December 2018
school: School of Pure and Applied Sciences
instructions: Answer question one and any other two

parts.text: Distinguish between catabolic and anabolic processes.
Explain significance of mitosis to continuity of life.
Describe the general characteristics of the DNA molecule.
State the functions of the cell membrane.
Based on the position of the centromere, describe different types of chromosomes.
Describe different types of vesicular transport citing an example in each case.
Discuss two types of chromatin highlighting the significance of each in cellular processes.

items.text: With an aid of well labeled diagrams describe the mitotic process in animals.
Describe the various types of plastids.
